Per episode_spec forbidden_subjects, no falling vehicle, no wreck, no victims, no rescue, no vigil, no memorial portrait, no US/UK street furniture, no postcard Italy. Per forbidden_claims, no Short names any defendant or states guilt flatly (the 16 July 2026 judgment is first instance and under appeal), no Short states a single agreed cause (two authoritative findings disagree), none says Morandi foresaw it or that the collapse was foreseen as fact, and every figure spoken is a verified script sentence backed by the FACTS_LEDGER. The register is concrete, steel strand, printed forms and empty boxes.

shorts.angle: The inspection found broken wires; the company's own manual says broken wires are a seventy, and a seventy means measures up to closing the road; the number written in the box was forty.
shorts.avoids: Names nobody and blames nobody by name; the scores, the manual's definitions and the commission's corrections are quoted as the record's own sentences. Does not say the collapse was foreseen, does not state a cause, does not mention the dead - this Short stays entirely inside the inspection paperwork.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: What was inside the concrete the inspectors were scoring - and what happened the one time anybody cut into it?
shorts.loop_join: The close - the easier thing was always to write a number in a box - is the hook's forty, named for what it was.

lines.text: On the first of August 2012, under a motorway viaduct in Genoa, an inspection recorded a beam with the concrete gone, the cables showing, and some of the wires broken.
source_lines: On the first of August 2012, under a motorway viaduct in Genoa, an inspection recorded a beam with the concrete gone, the cables showing, and some of the wires broken.

lines.text: Then the form asked for a number. The number written in the box was forty.
source_lines: Then the form asked for a number.
The number written in the box was forty.

lines.text: In the company's own manual, broken wires in the prestressing steel are a seventy. And a seventy means measures up to closing the road.
source_lines: In the company's own manual, broken wires in the prestressing steel are a seventy.
And a seventy means measures up to closing the road.

lines.text: There was a manual, written by the company, that said what each number meant and what each number obliged them to do.
source_lines: There was a manual, written by the company, that said what each number meant and what each number obliged them to do.

lines.text: In December 2006, steel bars severed by a slab failure. Scored forty.
source_lines: In December 2006, steel bars severed by a slab failure.
Scored forty.

lines.text: In June 2013, inside the box girders, in the chambers you have to climb into: corroded cables. Scored fifty. It was found in 2013 and never repaired.
source_lines: And in June 2013, inside the box girders, in the chambers you have to climb into: corroded cables.
Scored fifty.
It was found in 2013 and never repaired.

lines.text: Broken wires in the prestressing steel is the manual's own example of a seventy.
source_lines: Broken wires in the prestressing steel is the manual's own example of a seventy.

lines.text: It meant that the only way to know was to cut into it, and that the easier thing was always to write a number in a box.
source_lines: It meant that the only way to know was to cut into it, and that the easier thing was always to write a number in a box.

shorts.angle: Italy ordered a formal safety assessment of its strategic structures; the deadline for this viaduct was March 2013; in June 2017 the company wrote to the ministry that it had been carried out; the commission found it never was.
shorts.avoids: Does not say the company lied - the numbered letter and the commission's finding are placed side by side, each in its own verbatim sentence, and the juxtaposition is left to the viewer exactly as the film leaves it. Names nobody. Does not state a cause of the collapse or mention the dead. No claim about what the assessment would have found - only the commission's own conditional about what it was for.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: What did the same paper trail record about the project that was supposed to fix the stays - and who was allowed not to check it?
shorts.loop_join: The close - no safety analysis was ever made - is the document the hook promised: owed by law and never written.

lines.text: This is a story about a shell of concrete, a printed form, and a document that was owed by law and never written.
source_lines: This is a story about a shell of concrete, a printed form, and a document that was owed by law and never written.

lines.text: In 2003 Italy issued an order requiring the owners of strategic structures to carry out a formal assessment of their safety.
source_lines: In 2003 Italy issued an order requiring the owners of strategic structures — the ones that matter in a civil-protection emergency, or whose collapse would be serious — to carry out a formal assessment of their safety.

lines.text: For the Polcevera viaduct, the deadline was March 2013.
source_lines: For the Polcevera viaduct, the deadline was March 2013.

lines.text: In July 2014 the ministry asked where they had got to. The company replied that the assessments were about to be completed.
source_lines: In July 2014 the ministry's supervision directorate wrote to the motorway concession companies asking where they had got to.
The company replied that same month with assurances that the safety assessments were about to be completed.

lines.text: On the twenty-third of June 2017, in a numbered letter to the ministry, the company stated that for the Polcevera viaduct the assessment had been carried out.
source_lines: On the twenty-third of June 2017, in a numbered letter to the ministry, the company stated that for the Polcevera viaduct the assessment had been carried out.

lines.text: In the documents requested and obtained by this Commission, that assessment had not, at the date of delivery of the present report, in fact been carried out.
source_lines: In the documents requested and obtained by this Commission, that assessment had not, at the date of delivery of the present report, in fact been carried out.

lines.text: From that assessment would have come the best possible estimate of structural safety against the risk of collapse.
source_lines: From that assessment, if correctly carried out, would have come the best possible estimate of structural safety against the risk of collapse.

lines.text: For the Polcevera viaduct, no safety analysis and no seismic assessment of the viaduct was ever made.
source_lines: for the Polcevera viaduct, no safety analysis and no seismic assessment of the viaduct was ever made.

shorts.angle: The commission totalled thirty-six years of structural spending on the viaduct: ninety-eight per cent of it before the company was privatised in 1999, two per cent after - one point three million a year became twenty-three thousand.
shorts.avoids: Blames nobody by name and asserts no motive in the film's own voice - the profit sentence is the commission's, introduced as the commission's conclusion in the language of the concession contract. Does not state a cause of the collapse, does not mention the dead, does not say the spending caused anything. Every figure is a verified script sentence resting on the FACTS_LEDGER.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: What was the twenty-million-euro project those numbers ended in - and who was allowed to approve it?
shorts.loop_join: The close - the commission's sentence about maximised profits - loops back to the totalling exercise the hook opened with.

lines.text: The commission asked the company for everything it had spent on structural work on the whole viaduct, and totalled it.
source_lines: The commission asked the company for everything it had spent on structural work on the whole viaduct, and totalled it.

lines.text: From 1982 to 2018: twenty-four million, six hundred and ten thousand, five hundred euros.
source_lines: From 1982 to 2018: twenty-four million, six hundred and ten thousand, five hundred euros.

lines.text: Ninety-eight per cent of that was spent before 1999 — the year the motorway company was privatised. After 1999, two per cent.
source_lines: Ninety-eight per cent of that was spent before 1999 — the year the motorway company was privatised.
After 1999, two per cent.

lines.text: Before 1999 it averaged one point three million euros a year. After, twenty-three thousand.
source_lines: In the seventeen years to 1999, structural work on the Polcevera viaduct averaged one point three million euros a year.
In the nineteen years after it, it averaged twenty-three thousand.

lines.text: The whole list of structural works over thirty-six years is seven lines long.
source_lines: The whole list of structural works on that bridge, over thirty-six years, is seven lines long, and you can hear all of it.

lines.text: Then 2005: fifty thousand. That is the whole of it.
source_lines: Then 2005: fifty thousand.
2009: thirty-seven thousand five hundred.
2009 again: ninety-five thousand.
2015: two hundred and eighty-eight thousand.
That is the whole of it.

lines.text: The commission drew the obvious conclusion, and it wrote it down in the language of the concession contract.
source_lines: The commission drew the obvious conclusion, and it wrote it down in the language of the concession contract.

lines.text: Not doing simple ordinary maintenance today means wanting to do a great deal of extraordinary maintenance tomorrow, at certainly higher costs, with a mirror-image higher remunerativeness.
source_lines: Not doing simple ordinary maintenance today means wanting to do a great deal of extraordinary maintenance tomorrow, at certainly higher costs, with a mirror-image higher remunerativeness.
